definitions.gloss: female role; woman's part (in a play or performance)
definitions.explanation: A role portraying a female character in theater, film, or other performing arts. Particularly significant in traditional Japanese theater forms where male actors play female roles.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{女役|おんなやく}を{演|えん}じた。
この{劇|げき}では{女役|おんなやく}が{物語|ものがたり}の{鍵|かぎ}を{握|にぎ}っている。
examples.english: In this play, the female role holds the key to the story.

examples.japanese: {歌舞伎|かぶき}では{男性|だんせい}の{役者|やくしゃ}が{女役|おんなやく}を{務|つと}めることが{伝統|でんとう}となっている。
examples.english: In kabuki, it is a tradition for male actors to perform female roles.

notes:
Composed of {女|おんな} (woman) and {役|やく} (role, part). In traditional Japanese theater, the concept of men performing {女役|おんなやく} has deep cultural significance. In {歌舞伎|かぶき}, male actors specializing in female roles are called {女形|おやま}/{女方|おんながた}, and this specialization is passed down through family lines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女役|おんなやく}を{演|えん}じる: to play a female role
- {女役|おんなやく}を{務|つと}める: to serve as the female lead
- {女役|おんなやく}の{衣装|いしょう}: costume for a female role

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {女形|おんながた}/{女方|おんながた}: onnagata — a male kabuki actor specializing in female roles
- {男役|おとこやく}: male role — the counterpart; also significant in Takarazuka Revue
- {主役|しゅやく}: lead role — the principal character regardless of gender
